articles.title: Galaxy sets up $5 million fund to help shield Bitcoin against quantum computing threats
articles.snippet: The crypto financial services firm is funding developers to strengthen the blockchain's security before quantum computers become powerful enough to steal billions in crypto.

articles.title: Galaxy Commits Up to $5 Million to Prepare Bitcoin for Quantum Threat
articles.snippet: The crypto firm's initiative arrives as researchers, exchanges, and the U.S. government warn that "Q-Day" may land as soon as 2030.

articles.title: Bitcoin Q-Day Recovery Proposal Aims to Let Users Prove Ownership After Quantum Attack
articles.snippet: Project Eleven says a new post-quantum cryptographic proof could help Bitcoin users recover wallets after Q-Day by verifying ownership.
